title: Build plugins for Claude
subtitle: Submit plugins to the Claude directory through a new directory submission portal. Package MCP connectors and Agent Skills, track your plugin through review, and see how it's used and found once it's live

blocks.text: Every day, millions of people connect Claude to their apps, work tools, and data. Today, we're making it easier for developers to reach them.
blocks.html: Every day, millions of people connect Claude to their apps, work tools, and data. Today, we're making it easier for developers to reach them.

blocks.text: Plugins package MCP connectors, Agent Skills, or both, and are the main way to build third-party extensions for Claude. Build a plugin, submit it through the new directory submission portal, and once approved, it's listed in the Claude directory .
blocks.html: Plugins package MCP connectors, Agent Skills, or both, and are the main way to build third-party extensions for Claude. Build a plugin, submit it through the new directory submission portal, and once approved, it's listed in the Claude directory.

blocks.text: ‍ Submit and track plugins in the directory submission portal
blocks.html: ‍Submit and track plugins in the directory submission portal

blocks.text: The directory submission portal is open to developers on paid Claude plans. There are two ways to submit and get your plugin published in the Claude directory:
blocks.html: The directory submission portal is open to developers on paid Claude plans. There are two ways to submit and get your plugin published in the Claude directory:

items.text: Single MCP connector: point to your remote MCP server.
items.html: Single MCP connector: point to your remote MCP server.

items.text: Plugin bundle: combine MCP servers and skills, host them on GitHub, and submit the repo. In Claude Code, plugins can also include LSPs, commands, hooks, and agents.
items.html: Plugin bundle: combine MCP servers and skills, host them on GitHub, and submit the repo. In Claude Code, plugins can also include LSPs, commands, hooks, and agents.

items.text: Auto-validate your plugin. Each submission is checked and safety-scanned as soon as you submit, so you catch issues early.
items.html: Auto-validate your plugin. Each submission is checked and safety-scanned as soon as you submit, so you catch issues early.

items.text: Review status and feedback. See where your plugin is in the review process, results from the safety scan, and recommended changes.
items.html: Review status and feedback. See where your plugin is in the review process, results from the safety scan, and recommended changes.

items.text: Publish when you’re ready. Once approved, you decide when to publish your plugin in Claude.
items.html: Publish when you’re ready. Once approved, you decide when to publish your plugin in Claude.

blocks.text: Monitor and improve your plugin once it's published
blocks.html: Monitor and improve your plugin once it's published

blocks.text: Once your plugin is live, usage analytics show installs by product surface and version, so you can prioritize fixes and features for your users. On the discovery side, you’ll see how often your listing is viewed and which searches lead people to it, so you can refine it to reach new users.

blocks.text: Bring a rich experience to users with MCP 2.0 and its extensions
blocks.html: Bring a rich experience to users with MCP 2.0 and its extensions

blocks.text: Claude supports the latest MCP spec, commonly referred to as MCP 2.0 , which includes a stateless core. You can improve the experience of using your plugin with two MCP extensions : MCP Apps , for interactive UI inside chat, and Enterprise Managed Auth , for zero-touch OAuth for enterprise users. Support for more MCP features and extensions is coming soon.

Support for more MCP features and extensions is coming soon.

blocks.text: Plugins are the main way for third-party developers to create extensions for Claude. Over the coming weeks, one discovery experience will roll out across Claude and Claude Code. Skills and MCP connectors stay as building blocks, and the Claude directory will continue to list them. In the future, developers will be able to turn their connector listing into a plugin. If you have an existing skill, connector, or plugin on the Claude directory, you do not need to make any changes.
